message: Closing a rights request preserves fulfilment or refusal, identity checks where fulfilled, and a response with completion time.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:requestState ?state; cd:requestOutcome ?outcome. FILTER(?state IN (cd:requestState_Fulfilled,cd:requestState_Refused,cd:requestState_Closed)) FILTER((?state=cd:requestState_Fulfilled && ?outcome!=cd:requestOutcome_Fulfilled) || (?state=cd:requestState_Refused && ?outcome!=cd:requestOutcome_Refused) || ?outcome=cd:requestOutcome_Pending || !EXISTS {$this cd:responseEvidence ?e; cd:completedAt ?at} || (?outcome=cd:requestOutcome_Fulfilled && !EXISTS {$this cd:identityVerified true}) || (?outcome=cd:requestOutcome_Refused && !EXISTS {$this cd:refusalReason ?reason})) }

query:

SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:dispositionState cd:dispositionState_Completed; cd:disposedRecord ?record. ?hold a cd:LegalHold; cd:heldRecord ?record; cd:holdState cd:holdState_Active. }

message: A required business step cannot be skipped.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:requiredStep true; cd:stepState cd:stepState_Skipped. }

message: Predecessors belong to the same process, have lower sequence numbers and finish before a dependent step succeeds.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { {$this cd:previousStep+ $this} UNION {$this cd:previousStep ?prev; cd:stepSequence ?n; cd:stepState ?state. FILTER(!EXISTS {?process cd:processStep $this,?prev. ?prev cd:stepSequence ?p. FILTER(?p<?n)} || (?state=cd:stepState_Succeeded && !EXISTS {?prev cd:stepState ?s. FILTER(?s IN (cd:stepState_Succeeded,cd:stepState_Compensated,cd:stepState_Skipped))}))} }

message: Billing readiness considers actual unresolved blocking issues against the session.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:readinessState cd:readinessState_Ready; cd:session ?session. ?issue a cd:Issue; cd:affectedRecord ?session; cd:billingBlocking true; cd:issueState ?state. FILTER(?state NOT IN (cd:issueState_Resolved,cd:issueState_Closed)) }

message: An entitlement cannot outlive its finite funding agreement.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:serviceAgreement/cd:validUntil ?limit. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:validUntil ?end. FILTER(?end<=?limit)} }

message: Completed closure agrees with the account state, chronology and actual scoped access grants.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:closureState cd:closureState_Completed; cd:customer ?account; cd:requestedAt ?requested; cd:completedAt ?completed. FILTER(?completed<?requested || !EXISTS {?account cd:accountState cd:accountState_Closed} || EXISTS {?grant a cd:AccessGrant; cd:scopeRecord ?account; cd:grantState cd:grantState_Active}) }

message: Retirement or replacement cannot hide an unfinished session on the station.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:assetAction ?action; cd:station ?station. FILTER(?action IN (cd:assetAction_Replace,cd:assetAction_Decommission,cd:assetAction_Dispose)) ?session a cd:ChargingSession; cd:chargingUnit/cd:station ?station; cd:sessionState ?state. FILTER(?state NOT IN (cd:sessionState_Completed,cd:sessionState_Failed)) }

message: An ownership transfer identifies different previous and succeeding owners.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:previousOwner ?owner; cd:nextOwner ?owner. }

message: Applied and duplicate outcomes retain processing time no earlier than receipt.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:processingState ?state; cd:sourceEvent/cd:receivedAt ?received. FILTER(?state IN (cd:processingState_Applied,cd:processingState_Duplicate)) FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:processedAt ?processed. FILTER(?processed>=?received)} }

message: The disclosed price currency and optional display tariff agree with the commercial offer.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:currency ?cur; cd:selectedTariff ?tariff; cd:priceDisplay ?display. FILTER(!EXISTS {?display cd:displayCurrency ?cur} || !EXISTS {?tariff cd:currency ?cur} || EXISTS {?display cd:selectedTariff ?other. FILTER(?other!=?tariff)}) }

message: Refunds have positive amounts and confirmation requires an originally confirmed capture.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:refundAmount ?amount; cd:refundState ?state; cd:paymentCapture ?capture. FILTER(?amount<=0 || (?state=cd:refundState_Confirmed && !EXISTS {?capture cd:captureState cd:captureState_Confirmed})) }

message: A chargeback disputes a positive amount no greater than its confirmed capture in the same currency.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:disputedAmount ?amount; cd:currency ?cur; cd:paymentCapture ?capture. FILTER(?amount<=0 || !EXISTS {?capture cd:capturedAmount ?limit; cd:currency ?cur; cd:captureState cd:captureState_Confirmed. FILTER(?amount<=?limit)}) }

message: A confirmed payout is positive, pays the account holder and retains a confirmation no earlier than scheduling.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:payoutState cd:payoutState_Confirmed; cd:payoutAmount ?amount; cd:beneficiary ?party; cd:financialAccount ?account; cd:scheduledAt ?scheduled. FILTER(?amount<=0 || !EXISTS {?account cd:accountHolder ?party} || !EXISTS {$this cd:confirmedAt ?at. FILTER(?at>=?scheduled)}) }

message: Flexibility delivery records signed actual-minus-baseline energy; reduction is negative.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:actualEnergyKWh ?actual; cd:baselineEnergyKWh ?baseline; cd:deliveredAdjustmentKWh ?adjustment. FILTER(?adjustment!=?actual-?baseline) }

message: Simultaneous module allocations cannot exceed shared cabinet capacity; touching half-open intervals do not overlap.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:totalCabinetPowerKW ?capacity. {SELECT $this ?probe (SUM(?power) AS ?total) WHERE {{SELECT DISTINCT $this ?probe WHERE {?edge a cd:PowerModuleAllocation; cd:powerCabinet $this; cd:interval/cd:startsAt ?probe}} ?allocation a cd:PowerModuleAllocation; cd:powerCabinet $this; cd:allocatedPowerKW ?power; cd:interval ?window. ?window cd:startsAt ?start; cd:endsAt ?end. FILTER(?start<=?probe && ?probe<?end)} GROUP BY $this ?probe} FILTER(?total>?capacity) }

message: Closed service-level breaches retain evidence of the accepted resolution.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:breachState cd:breachState_Closed. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:closureEvidence ?e} }

message: A synchronization watermark cannot be later than its successful synchronization time.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:watermarkAt ?mark; cd:lastSuccessfulAt ?success. FILTER(?mark>?success) }

message: Commercial responsibility is bounded by its agreement while remaining usable for historical usage.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:validFrom ?start; cd:serviceAgreement ?a. ?a cd:validFrom ?from. OPTIONAL {?a cd:validUntil ?until} FILTER(?start<?from || (BOUND(?until) && !EXISTS {$this cd:validUntil ?end. FILTER(?end<=?until)})) }

message: Accepted session authorization precedes start and has not expired at start.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:sessionState ?state; cd:startedAt ?start; cd:authorizationDecision ?decision. FILTER(?state IN (cd:sessionState_Active,cd:sessionState_Suspended,cd:sessionState_Completed)) ?decision cd:decidedAt ?at. OPTIONAL {?decision cd:expiresAt ?expires} FILTER(?at>?start || (BOUND(?expires)&&?start>=?expires)) }

message: Payment state agrees with confirmed capture totals, including partial and fully refunded outcomes.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:paymentState ?state; cd:requestedAmount ?requested. {SELECT $this (SUM(?amount) AS ?captured) WHERE {OPTIONAL {?c a cd:PaymentCapture; cd:paymentIntent $this; cd:captureState cd:captureState_Confirmed; cd:capturedAmount ?amount}} GROUP BY $this} {SELECT $this (SUM(?refund) AS ?refunded) WHERE {OPTIONAL {?c a cd:PaymentCapture; cd:paymentIntent $this; cd:captureState cd:captureState_Confirmed. ?r a cd:Refund; cd:paymentCapture ?c; cd:refundState cd:refundState_Confirmed; cd:refundAmount ?refund}} GROUP BY $this} BIND(COALESCE(?captured,0) AS ?total) FILTER((?state IN (cd:paymentState_Created,cd:paymentState_Authorized,cd:paymentState_Failed,cd:paymentState_Cancelled) && ?total!=0) || (?state=cd:paymentState_Captured && (?total<=0 || ?total!=?requested)) || (?state=cd:paymentState_PartiallyCaptured && (?total<=0 || ?total>=?requested)) || (?state=cd:paymentState_Refunded && (?total<=0 || COALESCE(?refunded,0)!=?total))) }

message: Confirmed capture records represent a positive collected amount.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:captureState cd:captureState_Confirmed; cd:capturedAmount ?amount. FILTER(?amount<=0) }

message: Refund requests do not precede the original capture.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:requestedAt ?requested; cd:paymentCapture/cd:capturedAt ?captured. FILTER(?requested<?captured) }

message: Paid invoice status is backed by a settled same-currency position with collections and credits covering its gross amount.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:invoiceState cd:invoiceState_Paid; cd:currency ?cur; cd:grossAmount ?gross. FILTER NOT EXISTS {?p a cd:FinancialPosition; cd:sourceRecord $this; cd:currency ?cur; cd:positionState cd:positionState_Settled; cd:outstandingAmount ?outstanding; cd:originalAmount ?original; cd:collectedAmount ?collected; cd:creditedAmount ?credited; cd:writtenOffAmount ?written. FILTER(?outstanding=0 && ?original=?gross && ?collected+?credited=?gross && ?written=0)} }

message: An invoice-specific collection cannot be allocated to a different source obligation.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:allocationState cd:allocationState_Posted; cd:paymentCapture/cd:paymentIntent/cd:invoice ?invoice; cd:financialPosition/cd:sourceRecord ?source. FILTER(?invoice!=?source) }

message: An invoice credit is a positive reduction; negative credits cannot offset cumulative credit limits.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:creditAmount ?amount. FILTER(?amount<=0) }

message: Posted allocations cannot retain money already returned by confirmed refunds.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:capturedAmount ?captured. {SELECT $this (SUM(?v) AS ?allocated) WHERE {OPTIONAL {?a a cd:PaymentAllocation; cd:paymentCapture $this; cd:allocationState cd:allocationState_Posted; cd:allocatedAmount ?v}} GROUP BY $this} {SELECT $this (SUM(?v) AS ?refunded) WHERE {OPTIONAL {?r a cd:Refund; cd:paymentCapture $this; cd:refundState cd:refundState_Confirmed; cd:refundAmount ?v}} GROUP BY $this} FILTER(COALESCE(?allocated,0)+COALESCE(?refunded,0)>?captured) }

message: Cancelled subscriptions retain cancellation evidence time and disable renewal; ended periods have positive duration.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { {$this cd:startsAt ?start; cd:endsAt ?end. FILTER(?end<=?start)} UNION {$this cd:subscriptionState cd:subscriptionState_Cancelled. FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:cancelledAt ?at} || !EXISTS {$this cd:renewAutomatically false})} }

message: A billed subscription period retains a non-draft, non-void invoice in its currency.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:billingPeriodState cd:billingPeriodState_Billed; cd:currency ?cur. FILTER NOT EXISTS {$this cd:invoice ?invoice. ?invoice cd:currency ?cur; cd:invoiceState ?state. FILTER(?state NOT IN (cd:invoiceState_Draft,cd:invoiceState_Voided))} }

message: Settlement approval cannot conceal unresolved reconciliation cases directly against the batch or its items.
query:
PREFIX cd: <https://example.org/charge-domain#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT $this WHERE { $this cd:approvalState cd:approvalState_Approved; cd:settlementBatch ?batch. ?case a cd:ReconciliationCase; cd:caseState ?state. FILTER(?state!=cd:caseState_Resolved) {?case cd:expectedRecord ?record} UNION {?case cd:observedRecord ?record} FILTER(?record=?batch || EXISTS {?batch cd:settlementItem ?record}) }
